title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #16

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which book of the Bible begins with the words "In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth"? (1 mark)
   A. Luke
   B. Genesis
   C. Psalms
   D. Exodus

2. Which thought is likely to lead to a wrong action? (1 mark)
   A. I will thank my teacher
   B. I want to take what is not mine
   C. I will share my lunch
   D. I will help my friend

3. Which of these can help a child who is sad? (1 mark)
   A. Being rude to others
   B. Hiding alone for days
   C. Talking to a trusted adult and praying
   D. Refusing to eat

4. Which verse says that God's word is a lamp for our feet? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 12:1
   B. Psalm 119:105
   C. Acts 11:26
   D. Luke 15:8

5. Which choice is likely to bring a good result? (1 mark)
   A. Skipping class
   B. Telling a lie
   C. Copying from a friend
   D. Doing homework before playing

6. In a family tree, where are the grandparents normally placed? (1 mark)
   A. Outside the tree
   B. At the bottom
   C. In the middle with the children
   D. At the top

7. What does it mean to revere God? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore Him
   B. To forget Him
   C. To respect Him deeply and be in awe of Him
   D. To fear Him only

8. Which verse says that there is no one holy like the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. Isaiah 49:16
   B. Galatians 5:22
   C. 1 Samuel 2:2
   D. Luke 1:37

9. What did God first tell Balaam about going with Balak's messengers? (1 mark)
   A. Curse Israel
   B. Do not go with them
   C. Take a gift
   D. Go at once

10. What should a child do if they meet a dangerous animal? (1 mark)
   A. Go closer
   B. Throw stones
   C. Try to fight it
   D. Stay away and call adults

11. What is a famine? (1 mark)
   A. A feast
   B. A festival
   C. A long time when there is not enough food
   D. A river

12. Which verse says that all peoples on earth will be blessed through Abraham? (1 mark)
   A. John 3:16
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. Genesis 12:3
   D. Genesis 1:1

13. Where did John preach? (1 mark)
   A. Near the River Jordan
   B. In Egypt
   C. In Antioch
   D. In Rome

14. What did Bartimaeus call Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. King of Egypt
   B. Son of David
   C. Master of the house
   D. Priest

15. How should people with contagious diseases be treated? (1 mark)
   A. By making fun of them
   B. With insults
   C. With care and respect
   D. With rejection

16. What does Matthew 5:39 teach? (1 mark)
   A. Take what is yours
   B. Hit back harder
   C. Ignore everyone
   D. Do not resist an evil person by taking revenge

17. What is revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Hurting someone because they hurt you
   B. Praying
   C. Sharing
   D. Forgiving

18. Which of these is an emotional need? (1 mark)
   A. A meal
   B. A new pair of shoes
   C. Someone to listen
   D. A pencil

19. What does the kingdom of God mean? (1 mark)
   A. God's rule in the hearts of people who obey Him
   B. A school
   C. A country in Europe
   D. A big farm

20. How should we tell the truth? (1 mark)
   A. Rudely
   B. Loudly
   C. To hurt
   D. With love and respect

21. Which story is a fable about lying but is not in the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph
   B. Zacchaeus
   C. Balaam
   D. The shepherd boy and the wolf

22. Which verse tells children to obey parents in the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. John 3:16
   B. Ephesians 6:1
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. Genesis 12:1

23. What does obedience mean? (1 mark)
   A. Doing what you like
   B. Arguing
   C. Doing what those in authority say when it is good and right
   D. Refusing rules

24. How can we show love for God? (1 mark)
   A. By ignoring them
   B. By being rude
   C. By obeying His teachings
   D. By being greedy

25. Which action shows care for school property? (1 mark)
   A. Breaking chairs
   B. Writing on desks
   C. Keeping toilets clean
   D. Wasting water

26. What should you do when you sin? (1 mark)
   A. Repeat it
   B. Hide it
   C. Confess, say sorry and put things right
   D. Blame others

27. Which is a group that a child should not join? (1 mark)
   A. A Bible club
   B. A church choir
   C. A football team with good rules
   D. A gang that does wrong

28. What is a warning sign of an unsafe group? (1 mark)
   A. It tells you to keep secrets from parents
   B. It welcomes you kindly
   C. It encourages school work
   D. It teaches good manners

29. What does patience mean? (1 mark)
   A. Rushing
   B. Being angry
   C. Refusing to wait
   D. Waiting calmly without losing your temper

30. Which of these can harm the body? (1 mark)
   A. Drugs
   B. Clean water
   C. Fruit
   D. Rest

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Give two ways of showing love at home. (2 marks)

32. Describe what Jesus did to raise the widow's son. (3 marks)

33. State three reasons why we should pray every day. (3 marks)

34. State two promises that God made to Abram in Genesis 12:1-3. (2 marks)

35. Explain why we should bless and not curse others. (3 marks)

36. Explain how a child can show compassion at school and at home, and why prayer is important when facing challenges. (5 marks)

37. Give four things that help our faith to grow. (4 marks)

38. State three challenges that children may face and how they can involve God. (3 marks)

39. Describe four dangers of misusing social media. (4 marks)

40. State three reasons why we should care for school property. (3 marks)

41. State two ways of showing respect for the Bible. (2 marks)

42. Name two ways of expressing thanks to people who are kind to us. (2 marks)

43. Give two people you should pray for. (2 marks)

44. Explain how the parable shows God's love for the sinner and how a child can respond. (5 marks)

45. Give two ways of helping a person who is blind. (2 marks)

46. State three results of telling lies. (3 marks)

47. State two ways of respecting the church building. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Genesis
   Genesis 1:1 is the opening line of the Bible.

2. B — I want to take what is not mine
   Wanting to take what belongs to others leads to stealing.

3. C — Talking to a trusted adult and praying
   Sharing feelings with a trusted person and praying helps.

4. B — Psalm 119:105
   Psalm 119:105 compares God's word to a lamp and a light.

5. D — Doing homework before playing
   Doing your work first helps you learn and stay out of trouble.

6. D — At the top
   A family tree shows the oldest generation at the top.

7. C — To respect Him deeply and be in awe of Him
   Reverence is deep respect for God.

8. C — 1 Samuel 2:2
   1 Samuel 2:2 declares God's holiness.

9. B — Do not go with them
   God told him not to go and not to curse the people.

10. D — Stay away and call adults
   The story is not a call to fight animals.

11. C — A long time when there is not enough food
   A famine is a serious shortage of food.

12. C — Genesis 12:3
   Genesis 12:3 contains this promise.

13. A — Near the River Jordan
   John preached in the wilderness by the Jordan.

14. B — Son of David
   He called out, "Jesus, Son of David."

15. C — With care and respect
   Jesus showed kindness to those with leprosy.

16. D — Do not resist an evil person by taking revenge
   Jesus taught us to break the cycle of revenge.

17. A — Hurting someone because they hurt you
   Revenge is paying back harm.

18. C — Someone to listen
   Emotional needs include comfort and friendship.

19. A — God's rule in the hearts of people who obey Him
   God's kingdom is His rule.

20. D — With love and respect
   Truth should be told kindly.

21. D — The shepherd boy and the wolf
   The boy who cried wolf is a fable.

22. B — Ephesians 6:1
   Ephesians 6:1 says this.

23. C — Doing what those in authority say when it is good and right
   Obedience means following good instructions.

24. C — By obeying His teachings
   Jesus said love shows in obedience.

25. C — Keeping toilets clean
   Cleanliness respects property.

26. C — Confess, say sorry and put things right
   1 John 1:9 says God forgives those who confess.

27. D — A gang that does wrong
   Ungodly groups lead to harm.

28. A — It tells you to keep secrets from parents
   Secrets from parents are a warning.

29. D — Waiting calmly without losing your temper
   Patience is calm waiting.

30. A — Drugs
   Drugs harm the body and mind.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Obey parents, help with chores, be kind to siblings, care for younger children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: He felt compassion, told the woman not to cry, touched the bier and told the young man to get up.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for compassion, 1 for touching the bier, 1 for the command.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: We can thank God; ask for help; grow spiritually; know God better; get strength to avoid wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: To make him a great nation, to bless him, to make his name great, and to bless all peoples through him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid promise.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words can build up or break down people. God wants us to love others. Blessing brings peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the power of words, 1 for God's wish for love, 1 for peace.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: At school: share, comfort a sad classmate, include a lonely child. At home: help with chores, care for a sick family member. Prayer is important because God hears us and helps, and it gives peace and courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a school example, 1 for a home example, 1 for God hearing, 1 for peace or courage, 1 for clear link to compassion.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: Prayer, Bible reading, worship with others, obedience, good friends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid thing up to 4.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Illness, loss of a loved one, lack of school fees, bullying, exams. They can pray, trust God and ask trusted adults for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid challenge with a way of involving God, up to 3.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: Strangers, harmful content, bullying, too much screen time, rumours, sharing private details.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each danger up to 4.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: It belongs to everyone; repair costs money; a clean school helps learning; others will use it later.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep it clean, carry it carefully, keep it in a high safe place, wash hands before reading, do not write in it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say thank you, write a card, help them in return.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parents, guardians, friends, teachers, sick people, leaders.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: God searches for lost people like the woman for her coin. He is happy when a person repents. A child can respond by saying sorry to God, turning away from wrong, living a righteous life, and caring for others who go astray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's search, 1 for God's joy, 1 for saying sorry, 1 for righteous living, 1 for caring for others.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Greet them by name, offer to guide, include them, do not tease.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Loss of trust, punishment, guilt, broken friendships.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each result.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Enter quietly, do not litter, keep phones silent, take care of Bibles.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
